title: PBA sets meeting with Titan Ultra players, mulls dispersal draft

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines– The PBA is set to meet with all players previously under contract with Titan Ultra to discuss the next step following the league’s decision to revoke the franchise of the team owned by Pureblends Corporation. Ogie Narvasa, who serves as the league’s legal counsel, said a meeting has been set for next week regarding the removal of the Giant Risers from the PBA for violations committed under its constitution and by-laws.
